synth.notes:
Sokoban-style token game on a 3px grid: A1-4 move the player 3px; moving into tokens makes the hit chain slide (picking up tokens it touches) until a member hits a wall, and the player stays put.
A6 click on a token: the player takes over its position and shape, and that token is removed. Blocks are renamed token_i by (y,x).
Walls have no pixels in the extractor, so 3 wall rectangles are inferred from blocked moves and slide stops. Ablation: removing the y=27 or (12,48) wall fails t9 or t17.
Hypothesis (block A3 touching portal, mixed outcomes) is a red herring: the outcome depends only on whether the player pushes. No hidden state; the program is stateless.
Unconfirmed: the wall layout beyond observed stops, whether sockets affect sliding, A5/A7 (unobserved, so treated as no-op), and what the reset steps 55/67 did.
